description: This file defines a React component and related functions for channel suggestion and switching in Mattermost, including fetching channels, filtering, sorting, and rendering suggestions.

classes.name: SwitchChannelProvider
classes.description: Main class providing channel switch suggestions, fetching channels, filtering, sorting, and rendering suggestion components.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the input pretext, triggers local filtering and server fetch for channels and users.

methods.name: initialFilteredList
methods.description: Creates initial filtered list of channels based on prefix.

methods.name: fetchUsersAndChannels
methods.description: Fetches matching users and channels from server and updates suggestions.

methods.name: userWrappedChannel
methods.description: Creates a wrapped channel object for user profiles.

methods.name: formatGroup
methods.description: Formats a list of channels and users into suggestion items.

methods.name: removeChannelsFromArchivedTeams
methods.description: Filters out channels from archived teams.

methods.name: fetchAndFormatRecentlyViewedChannels
methods.description: Fetches and formats recently viewed channels for suggestions.

methods.name: getThreadsItem
methods.description: Returns a thread item with unread counts.

methods.name: getLastViewedAt
methods.description: Calculates last viewed timestamp for a channel.

methods.name: wrapChannels
methods.description: Wraps raw channels into suggestion items with additional info.

methods.name: fetchChannels
methods.description: Fetches all channels for the current team and formats for suggestions.
